params.name: aPointer
params.description: Pointer for which to retrieve the referenced object

params.name: varName

sentinelValues.meaning: referenced object is NIL, a table, or a field

params.description: Name of referenced variable or empty string

params.name: tableNum

sentinelValues.meaning: referenced object is a variable, array, or array element (not a table/field)

params.description: Number of referenced table or array element or 0 or -1

sentinelValues.meaning: referenced object is NIL or a table
referenced object is a variable, array, or array element

overloads.semanticRole: Retrieves what an existing pointer references (NIL, a variable, an array, an array element, a table, or a field) and decodes that identity into varName/tableNum/fieldNum.

constraints: aPointer must be an actual pointer expression, or a syntax error occurs.
Does not work with pointers to local variables, since several local variables with the same name can exist in different locations.
